info.name: Livestock ERP Financial and Staff API
info.description: Postman collection for Staff Master and Financial cashbook APIs: staff records, category setup, category summaries, cashbook setup, manual transaction drafts, confirmation, reversal, ledger, daily summary, and consolidated balances. All endpoints use /api/v1. Manual transaction creation requires an Idempotency-Key header. This collection does not cover staff advances, depreciation, period controls, or P&L.

request.description: Logs in and stores the Sanctum access token in the access_token collection variable.
Lists categories. Filter by direction=in or out, status, or search. Each category has exactly one cash direction.

response.name: List Cash Ledger Categories

request.description: Creates an active cash-in category. Category name must be unique within its direction.
Creates an active cash-out category. Category name must be unique within its direction.
Links the cash-in category to its opposite-direction category. Configure the reciprocal link on the cash-out category too if both categories can be reversed.

item.name: Pair Cash Out Category for Reversals

request.description: Sets the reciprocal cash-in category used when reversing a cash-out transaction.

response.name: Pair Cash Out Category for Reversals

request.description: Returns a category and its configured reversal category.
Updates a category. Name and direction are locked after a category is used by a cash transaction or ledger entry.
Blocks deactivation while a draft transaction uses this category. Reactivate with status=active.
Lists staff within the signed-in user's branch scope. Optional filters: search (staff code, name, or phone), branch_id, status, employment_status, and per_page.

response.name: List Staff

request.description: Creates staff with a unique staff code, name, branch, and employment status. Phone is optional. New staff records are active by default. Branch access is enforced server-side.

response.name: Create Staff

request.description: Returns staff identity, branch, employment status, active/inactive status, and advance eligibility. Advance balance is supplied by the advance ledger when that module is implemented.
Updates staff details. Employment status can be changed to terminated; active/inactive is controlled separately.
Toggles the staff record between active and inactive. Only active, employed staff are eligible for a new advance.
Lists cashbooks within the authenticated user's branch scope. Optional filters: branch_id, type, status, currency_code, search, and per_page.

request.description: Creates an active cashbook and records its opening balance as a ledger entry. Opening balance may be omitted and then defaults to zero. Set branch_id to an active branch you can access. The name must be unique for that branch and cash/bank type.
Returns cashbook details and the system-calculated current balance.
Updates descriptive fields. Branch, type, currency, effective date, and opening balance cannot be changed after creation.
Deactivation is blocked while draft transactions exist or the current balance is non-zero.
Lists immutable ledger entries in posting order. Optional filters: from_date, to_date, direction, source_type, search, and per_page.

request.description: Creates a draft without changing the cashbook balance. Choose a category whose direction matches the transaction. Idempotency-Key is required. Keep the same key when retrying this request; change idempotency_key and external_reference to create a different transaction.
Returns transaction details, posting reference, and reversal links.
Edits a draft only. Confirmed or reversed transactions are immutable.
Revalidates cashbook status, business date, and available balance, then appends one ledger entry atomically. Repeating confirmation does not post again.
Reverses a confirmed manual transaction with an equal and opposite ledger entry. Transactions owned by another module must be reversed through that module.
Returns branch and type totals grouped by currency. Optional filters: branch_id, type, and currency_code. Different currencies are never combined.
Summarizes posted cash movements by category and direction, grouped by currency. Optional filters: branch_id, cashbook_id, currency_code, direction, and category_id. Opening balances are excluded.
